lesson_text:
[Prof. Harrington — Finance Fundamentals — Head of Valuation & Accounting]

Today's Topic: The Three Financial Statements

How the P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statement connect. Build intuition for how a single transaction flows through all three.

Key Concepts We Will Master Today:
  • revenue recognition
  • accrual vs. cash accounting
  • retained earnings link

Prof. Harrington's Opening:
Let me start with a question: why does a highly profitable company sometimes run out of cash? The answer is the foundation of everything we cover today. Keep that question in mind as we work through the material — by the end of the session, you will answer it with precision.
